## What's new

- **Place objects from other acts.** The object gallery (View → Objects) has an **Act** choice. Pick another act and its objects are listed with the id that reaches them from your map's act, as WinDS1 maps do: the game reads a map's object ids in its own act's table and runs on into the neighbouring acts' (150 objects per act). So in an Act 5 map, Act 1's Rogue Fountain is object **-600**, and Act 4's objects are -150 to -1. Click one and place it as usual; DS1 Studio shows the right sprite and name. NPCs still come from the map's own act.
